answer: Divergent-History Attestation. Each identity must periodically sign a random nonce chained to its prior signed history, and peers reject any identity whose chain forks—since clones share an origin, they cannot produce divergent signed histories without contradiction. A sybil farm must then maintain one coherent, independently evolving ledger per fake identity, multiplying storage and signing work per clone. The ridge of accumulated state makes mass duplication costly; a willow branch cannot fork unnoticed, and each lotus of forged identity pays full maintenance overhead.
